trends.name: Iran-Israel Escalation & Oil Supply Risk
trends.summary: IDF approved Iran operations for next 3 weeks with Iranian officers already killed in Isfahan; Trump proposing toll charges for Strait of Hormuz passage. Market concern centers on supply shock translating to growth shock—oil prices rising while inflation pressures persist, limiting Fed easing options despite 4.25% unemployment.

trends.name: Retail Investor Fear & Put/Call Reversal
trends.summary: ROBO Put/Call Ratio hit 20-year high of 1.0, indicating retail traders buying nearly equal puts and calls—a major fear signal. This suggests retail sentiment has shifted to defensive hedging as market volatility spikes, potentially signaling capitulation or imminent reversal.

trends.name: Fed Trapped on Dual Mandate
trends.summary: Rising oil prices driving inflation higher while unemployment remains firm at 4.25%, preventing Fed from easing policy. Both sides of the Fed mandate are hawkish—stagflation risk persists with no policy relief in sight for equity markets.

trends.name: Chinese EV Market Penetration Into US
trends.summary: Geely model review signals Chinese automakers gaining U.S. market traction; simultaneously, senators including Schumer calling for ban on Chinese vehicles manufactured/titled in Canada and Mexico. Trade war escalation risk paired with structural shift in auto competition.

trends.name: Private Credit Redemption Domino Effect
trends.summary: Blue Owl, Cliffwater and other private-credit managers facing redemption requests triggering cascading stress across funds. Signals liquidity concerns in alternative assets and potential contagion to broader credit markets as investors seek exits.

trends.name: Dollar Weakness & Debt Spiral Concerns
trends.summary: U.S. running massive current account deficit requiring constant inflows to break even; Japanese retail has been major funding source pouring savings into U.S. stocks (particularly AI). ZeroHedge warning of debt spiral ending in dollar destruction—yen weakness and flow dependency create currency risk.

trends.name: Gold Trading Volume Tripled to $361B/Day
trends.summary: Gold average daily trading volume nearly tripled from $134B (2021) to $361B (2025), now trading more than most major financial assets. Reflects investor flight-to-safety and concerns about macro instability, currency, and inflation hedging demand.

trends.name: Amazon-USPS Deal Reshapes Logistics
trends.summary: Amazon reaches deal with USPS for 1+ billion annual package deliveries (80% of current business), fundamentally reshaping last-mile economics. Major strategic shift reducing Amazon's delivery cost structure and signaling consolidation in logistics industry.

trends.name: OpenAI vs Musk Antitrust Battle Escalates
trends.summary: OpenAI formally asks California and Delaware to investigate Musk's 'anti-competitive behavior' ahead of April trial. Mirrors broader AI governance debates with major stakes for industry structure and market access in AI sector.

trends.name: Value Stocks Under Pressure Amid Turbulence
trends.summary: One of last defensive havens—value stocks—now in danger as market turbulence persists. Combined with sentiment data showing retail fear at 20-year highs, suggests broader market stress spreading to traditional safe havens.

trends.name: Nuclear Energy as Strategic Security Play
trends.summary: Iran conflict spotlighting nuclear energy's role in global energy security; clean energy stocks gaining attention as oil volatility rises. Geopolitical instability driving diversification into non-fossil energy assets and infrastructure plays.

trends.name: Alphabet & AI Mega-Caps Valuation Debate
trends.summary: Alphabet trading at 27x P/E with debate on whether 'strong money' is justified in current environment. Broader question on whether mega-cap AI valuations can sustain amid rising rates, capital flight to safety, and softening growth outlook.
